The True Glow story

When you look great,
you feel great.

Ever felt you open your wardrobe and have nothing to wear? Most of us do. We buy what looks good on someone else — in a store, on Instagram — and wonder why it never feels quite right.

After 12 years in corporate tech and discovering colour consulting in London, I saw the transformative power colour and style has on our whole appearance — and how it makes us feel.

We are all unique. We each have our own colours, our own style, that when we find them — make us truly glow.

The session

A personal colour analysis
like no other

Every session is one-to-one, deeply personal, and tailored entirely to you. Using 144 professional colour drapes, we discover your unique season and rate all 36 colours in your palette.

You leave with a complete True Glow colour pack — your colour card, makeup guide, jewellery guide, and your personal star and impact colours.

A relaxed, luxurious experience in Oberwil bei Zug — overlooking the beautiful lake of Zug.

Get in touch
For companies

Colour, Style &
Professional Presence

In partnership with a stylist, True Glow brings together the science of colour analysis and the strategy of personal style — helping your people show up with confidence, credibility and professional presence at your company event, wellness day or leadership programme.

Our signature workshop: Colour, Style & Professional Presence — helping professionals show up with confidence through the science of colour and the strategy of personal style.

Keynote Talk
1 hour

An inspiring talk on the power of colour and personal style — how the colours and clothes you choose shape the way you show up, project authority and feel confident at work. Can be delivered as a lunch-and-learn, employee network event or wellbeing initiative.

Colour, Style & Professional Presence
Half day · up to 20 people

Our signature interactive workshop, co-led with a stylist. It explores how colour and style become practical tools for confidence, professional presence and simpler everyday dressing — including how colour influences perception, building a wardrobe that works harder with fewer, better choices, and creating a professional image that feels authentic to each person's role.

Executive VIP Day
Full day · on-site

Includes the keynote talk, followed by individual simplified colour draping and personal styling sessions for each team member at your premises. Each person discovers their colour season and leaves with their personal colour profile and tailored style guidance.

Pricing is tailored to your event size and format. Get in touch to discuss what works best for your team.

About Pauline

A French eye
for colour

With a French upbringing and over 12 years in the corporate world between London and Zurich, I understand what it means to show up with authority. Colour is one of the most powerful — and most overlooked — tools any professional, woman or man, has.

I trained as a colour analyst at Red Leopard — a prestigious London establishment with a discreet clientele that includes some of the world's most high-profile individuals. Before that, I spent 12 years in senior sales roles at top tech companies — including Salesforce and Criteo — so I know first-hand how much personal presence matters in a boardroom.

Today I work with individual clients from my studio in Zug and deliver corporate workshops across the Zurich and Zug region. Your wardrobe is one of the most powerful tools you have — it shapes your confidence, your credibility, and how you show up every day.
